description: Place each named interval's two endpoints on a shared line so interval overlap realizes exactly the requested neighbor graph.

name: Knowledge Circle
mechanic: Apply a sequence of truthful public knowledge announcements by retaining exactly the worlds compatible with what each observer knows, then recomputing their information groups after each announcement.
description: Apply a sequence of truthful public knowledge announcements by retaining exactly the worlds compatible with what each observer knows, then recomputing their information groups after each announcement.
rules: For the displayed public announcement choose exactly the active worlds where it is true, then Apply simultaneously.
An observer knows a statement only if it holds in every active world with their same private observation. Not knowing differs from knowing the negation.
Removed worlds disappear from every observer’s groups before the next announcement. Three incorrect survivor sets end an attempt.
Complete all three finite studies. Reset recovers the current attempt; Restart begins the campaign again with the displayed replay seed.

Self-referential truth assignment is one simultaneous Boolean solution; this is a transcript of changing knowledge states.

name: Modal Witness

description: Build a small world/reachability model in which every premise is true at the root and the proposed modal conclusion is false.

name: Polygon Passport
mechanic: Pair directed polygon sides and choose gluing orientation to create a closed surface with the requested vertex identifications, Euler characteristic and orientability.
description: Pair directed polygon sides and choose gluing orientation to create a closed surface with the requested vertex identifications, Euler characteristic and orientability.
rules: Choose two unpaired directed boundary sides, choose reversed or same-arrow identification, then Pair. Pair every side once.
Reversed gluing identifies start with partner end; same-arrow gluing identifies start with start. Vertex classes update by transitive identification.

Completed Euler characteristic is vertex classes minus paired edges plus one face. Meet orientability and vertex-class targets in three authored finite studies. Three failed certifications end the attempt.

name: Hairpin Studio
mechanic: Pair complementary sites on one strand into a nested folding diagram, trading strong bonds and stacking bonuses against minimum loop gaps and forbidden crossings.
description: Pair complementary sites on one strand into a nested folding diagram, trading strong bonds and stacking bonuses against minimum loop gaps and forbidden crossings.
rules: Choose two unused complementary sites and add a bond. A pairs with B; C with D.
Bonds may nest or remain separate, never interlace. Respect the printed minimum interior gap and count neighboring nested stacking bonuses.

description: Assign distinct decimal digits to repeated letter symbols and account for actual column carries so a written addition is valid.

name: Fill-In Station
mechanic: Choose a vertex elimination order that completes each eliminated neighborhood into a clique while keeping induced degree and newly created fill edges within limits.
description: Choose a vertex elimination order that completes each eliminated neighborhood into a clique while keeping induced degree and newly created fill edges within limits.

name: Alternating Couriers
mechanic: Walk an alternating path from an unmatched left vertex to an unmatched right vertex, then flip every path edge to enlarge a matching without losing previous assignments.
description: Walk an alternating path from an unmatched left vertex to an unmatched right vertex, then flip every path edge to enlarge a matching without losing previous assignments.
rules: Start at an unmatched left vertex. Alternate an unmatched edge to the right, then that vertex’s matched edge back left.
Finish at an unmatched right vertex and Flip the complete path; the matching grows by exactly one while rerouting previous assignments.
Traversal and canceled-path moves consume the allowance. Deliver a complete matching before the budget ends.

Hall Window certifies that assignment is impossible using a deficient union; these graphs are assignable and the player constructs a matching through augmenting paths.
Euler traversal consumes each graph edge exactly once; augmentation revisits a changing matched/unmatched edge state to repair assignments.

name: Recursive Rings
mechanic: Release a nested ring chain by manipulating lower rings to unlock each higher ring, while fitting a tight move allowance.
description: Release a nested ring chain by manipulating lower rings to unlock each higher ring, while fitting a tight move allowance.
rules: Ring 1 may always toggle. Ring i needs ring i−1 attached and every lower ring 1…i−2 detached.
Temporary reattachment can unlock a higher ring. Toggle only one unlocked ring per move.
Release every ring within the finite move allowance; the authored three-, four- and five-ring studies have no generated stream.

Thermometers assign prefix lengths under row/column sums; recursive rings must navigate legal intermediate configurations within a move budget.

name: Heritage House

description: Infer unknown two-copy genotypes on a fixed family diagram from visible inherited traits, known carriers and parent/child allele transmission constraints.
rules: Cycle unknown fixed-family genotypes through aa, Aa, AA and unknown; visible known genotype clues cannot be edited.
A dominant trait permits AA or Aa; a recessive trait requires aa. A child inherits one allele copy from each listed parent.
Infer any assignment consistent with all visible traits, clues and transmissions. Three incorrect family reviews end an attempt.

name: Posterior Post
mechanic: Choose which costly noisy observation to obtain, update actual nonzero likelihood-weighted beliefs, then stop with the response minimizing asymmetric expected loss plus investigation cost.
description: Choose which costly noisy observation to obtain, update actual nonzero likelihood-weighted beliefs, then stop with the response minimizing asymmetric expected loss plus investigation cost.
rules: Purchase unused sealed probes and multiply class probabilities by their strictly positive result likelihoods, then normalize.

A negative result uses one minus the printed positive likelihood. Paid probe costs accumulate; classes retain positive probability. Paid observations cannot be rewound with Undo; Reset begins a new attempt at this finite contract.
Stop with a response whose posterior expected loss plus paid costs meets the contract. An over-budget purchase or excessive-loss commitment ends the attempt.
Complete all three finite studies. Reset recovers the current attempt; Restart begins the campaign again with the displayed replay seed.
controls: Labeled native buttons support touch, click, Tab and Enter/Space. Integer interval sliders also have visible step buttons; no keyboard-only gesture is required.

Privacy designs response distributions under ratio/accuracy constraints; it does not update beliefs from obtained observations or choose a risk-sensitive stopping action.

name: Heap Foundry
mechanic: Repair a binary min-heap through actual parent/child exchanges, extract the root, and reheapify the shrinking shape before the next extraction within a swap allowance.
description: Repair a binary min-heap through actual parent/child exchanges, extract the root, and reheapify the shrinking shape before the next extraction within a swap allowance.
rules: Select a tree slot and explicitly swap its value with its parent or direct child. Meet the swap allowance.
Every parent must be no greater than either child before Extract. An unsafe extraction loses immediately.
Extraction removes the minimum root and brings the last leaf to the root of the shrinking shape. Repair again until every value is extracted in order.
Complete all three finite studies. Reset recovers the current attempt; Restart begins the campaign again with the displayed replay seed.

Despite its name Heap Garden is contiguous storage allocation/compaction, not a priority heap.

name: Diagram Order
mechanic: Choose one global variable order for a reduced binary decision diagram so repeated cofactors share nodes and irrelevant tests vanish, meeting a node budget for the whole truth function.
description: Choose one global variable order for a reduced binary decision diagram so repeated cofactors share nodes and irrelevant tests vanish, meeting a node budget for the whole truth function.

Prefix coding merges weighted trees to minimize transmission cost; BDD order minimizes shared decision nodes of one Boolean function.

name: Turning Council
mechanic: Place a stone on a 6×6 board, then rotate one 3×3 quadrant by 90° before the opponent's complete turn; plan both placement and the rearranged existing lines.
description: Place a stone on a 6×6 board, then rotate one 3×3 quadrant by 90° before the opponent's complete turn; plan both placement and the rearranged existing lines.
rules: From each balanced tactical opening, place one stone in an empty square, then rotate any 3×3 quadrant 90 degrees. Both colors rotate together.
A sole horizontal, vertical or diagonal line of five after the required rotation wins. Simultaneous fives/full board are draws requiring another attempt.
The house makes a complete placement-plus-rotation turn using the displayed policy. Complete three distinct tactical duels, or choose a seeded tactical match series.

nearestExisting.difference: Gravity alignment fixes every played stone and chooses a column; quadrant rotation moves groups of both sides' existing stones after each free placement and changes threat geometry.
The2×2 cube is a single-player orientation/permutation restoration puzzle; this is adversarial evolving line construction with new stones and mandatory subboard rotation.
Wrapping row/column shifts restore a fixed permutation; this changes an adversarial board and its lines after each placement.

description: Build an existential witness strategy whose choices may depend only on preceding universal choices, and verify every universal branch rather than one convenient tuple.

Type sockets unify shared unknown structures; this is finite first-order quantifier game semantics with committed versus contingent choices.

Balance feedback deterministically filters heavy/light worlds; robust questioning retains histories with one permitted discrepancy and proves worst-case identification.

name: Invariant Gallery
